result.instructions: Tools for ServiceMinder, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments are booked for our service agents tomorrow?"; "Find the contact for Jane Smith and show her open proposals."; "List the invoices from last month that are still unpaid.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ServiceMinder data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run serviceminder_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run serviceminder_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run serviceminder_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. serviceminder_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: serviceminder_locate_contacts
tools.title: Find contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by name, phone, email, address, contact ID, tag or category. Needs a brand-scoped API key. Calls POST /api/contacts/locate.

digital_tracking_id.description: Digital tracking ID of a lead.

created_from.description: Date or date-time, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

created_through.description: Date or date-time, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

tags.description: Tag names; a contact must have them.

return_payment_on_file.description: Include the payment method on file (default false).

tools.name: serviceminder_query_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments by date range, last change, contact or service agent. Pages with skip and take (max 500). Calls POST /api/appointments/query.

from_date.description: Appointments on or after this date.

through_date.description: Appointments on or before this date.

updated_from.description: Appointments changed on or after this time.

updated_through.description: Appointments changed on or before this time.

tools.name: serviceminder_query_proposals
tools.title: List proposals
tools.description: List proposals by scope, date, acceptance date, owner or contact. The public docs do not list scope values, so pass the scope name your account uses. Calls POST /api/proposal/query.

scope.description: Scope name your account uses. Sent only when given.

from_date.description: Date or date-time, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

through_date.description: Date or date-time, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

from_accepted.description: Proposals accepted on or after this time.

through_accepted.description: Proposals accepted on or before this time.

updated_from.description: Date or date-time, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

updated_through.description: Date or date-time, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

updated_through.description: Date or date-time, for example 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T09:00:00.

tools.name: serviceminder_add_or_update_contact
tools.title: Add or update contact

zip.description: Postal code. Lead distribution uses it.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to set, by field name.

distribute_lead.description: Route the lead to the organization that owns the postal code. Brand-scoped key only.

tools.name: serviceminder_add_contact_note

task_type.description: Task type number from your ServiceMinder account.
